some micron-sized TiC precipitates form and distribute in the FCC matrix in a strip-like arrangement (Fig. 1c).

numerous square nano-sized precipitates are also observed in higher magnification BSE image (the inset of Fig. 1c). The average size and volume fraction of the nano-sized precipitates are about 67 ± 3 nm and 1.8%, respectively. The crystal structure of the nano-sized precipitates is further analyzed by TEM. Fig. 1d shows a bright field (BF) TEM image of the precipitates in the 0.4Ti HEA. The corresponding selected area electron diffraction (SAED) patterns in the inset of Fig. 1d confirm that the precipitates are TiC.
The average grain size of the 3.3C HEA is approximately 65 ± 6 μm.
